title: Can yesterday's tree survive?
hook: Change a tree while keeping its old version accessible.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Path-copy only changed search-tree nodes so an old version stays valid.

misconception: Saving a tree version requires cloning every node or mutating history.
objective: Path-copy only changed search-tree nodes so an old version stays valid.

claims.text: Only nodes on the changed search path are copied. Untouched subtrees retain their identities, while the original root still reaches the original version; persistence does not require copying the whole tree.
